notes: Bodies and clothes keep their state. Walk through the rain without an umbrella and you get damp, wet, then soaked (thin fabric goes see-through) and stay that way until you dry off or change. Spills leave stains until the clothes come off, mud stays on, crying smudges makeup, training leaves people sweaty until they shower, and everyone wakes up with bed hair until they fix it. A shower leaves hair wet for a while.

Homes change over time: dishes stack up in the sink, mess builds day by day until someone does chores, laundry piles up with every outfit change, and groceries people bring home go in the fridge, get cooked, and spoil. When you're at someone's place the story sees all of it.
